meaning:
locusts
Another spelling of gi.vay (גֹּבַי "locust" H1462B)

elsewhere.note: Thus the Lord Yahweh showed me: and behold, he formed locusts in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and behold, it was the latter growth…
Your guards are like the locusts, and your officials like the swarms of locusts, which settle on the walls on a cold day, but when the sun appears, they flee…
